mapper.insert: insert into JGUserInfo (userId, userPwd, userImg, userName, userUpdate, userTotalPointer, addressData,addressDetailData, userAddressDetail) value (#{userId}, #{userPwd}, #{userImg}, #{userName}, NOW(), #{userTotalPointer}, #{addressData},#{addressDetailData} ,#{userAddressDetail})
mapper.select: select userName from JGUserInfo where userCode = #{int}
